name: threadleaf
description: An open runtime for local Markdown vaults and community plugins.
author: Threadleaf contributors

scripts.build: pnpm run build:main && pnpm run build:renderer && pnpm run build:verify
scripts.check: pnpm run format:check && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test && pnpm run build
scripts.pack:dir: pnpm run build && electron-builder --linux dir --x64 --publish never
scripts.pack:linux: pnpm run build && electron-builder --linux AppImage rpm --x64 --publish never
scripts.pack:mac:arm64: pnpm run build && electron-builder --mac dmg zip --arm64 --publish never --config.mac.identity=null --config.mac.hardenedRuntime=false
scripts.pack:mac:universal: pnpm run build && electron-builder --mac dmg zip --universal --publish never --config.mac.forceCodeSigning=true --config.extraMetadata.threadleafUpdateTrust=signed-release-v1
scripts.pack:mac:x64: pnpm run build && electron-builder --mac dmg zip --x64 --publish never --config.mac.identity=null --config.mac.hardenedRuntime=false
scripts.pack:windows: pnpm run build && electron-builder --win nsis zip --x64 --publish never
scripts.pack:windows:signed: pnpm run build && electron-builder --win nsis zip --x64 --publish never --config.win.forceCodeSigning=true --config.extraMetadata.threadleafUpdateTrust=signed-release-v1
scripts.release:linux: pnpm run check && pnpm run pack:linux && pnpm run test:linux-packages && node scripts/package-reproducible-linux.mjs --write
scripts.test:packaged: pnpm run pack:dir && xvfb-run -a node scripts/check-packaged-app.mjs
